w: During Swamishri's puja, kishores sang bhajans with the accompaniment of instruments.

The evening program presentations included a traditional, colorful dance, singing of kirtans and an interesting discussion about the divine, redemptory attributes of Swamishri. The kishores then sang a bhajan "Chhana, chhana, chhana tame kya sudhi chhana rehesho." Then they asked Swamishri to reveal his true form to them. In his blessings Swamishri began, "I am a sadhu of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and the servant of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj and my name is Narayanswarupdas..."

The Guru Punam assembly commenced with bhajans and speeches by sadhus. Pujya Viveksagar Swami, Pujya Doctor Swami and Pujya Mahant Swami discoursed about the glory of the guru tradition in India and the divinity of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. The program was interlaced with bhajans and with colorful folk dances by kishores. When a light rainshower started Swamishri was requested to stop it because 35,000 devotees had assembled for the festival. Swamishri looked at the sky and the rain stopped immediately, but it poured heavily in the neighboring villages of Rudel, Dharmaj, Borsad, Dabhasi, etc. Finally, Swamishri blessed the Guru Punam assembly, "... Generally people do not like talks related to God or satsang. We do not like going to satsang. Our senses and mind do not like satsang, it is only the jiva that likes it. One has to remove one's base instincts, worldly desires, ego and attachment for worldly things. Only when this dirt is removed can one experience peace and happiness within... I pray on this day of Guru Punam that may God remain foremost in our souls. May spiritual knowledge be consolidated in our lives. And may there be peace everywhere..."

Kishore - Kishori Din In the evening, during the main Kishore-Kishori Din programme, kishores presented a drama that illustrated the main problems they face in the school environment and the role of personal satsang as the solution to these problems. In his blessings, Swamishri stated that the values and culture prevalent in India must also be practiced here. He also emphasised satsang and education, and the loving relationship that must be cultivated between parents and their children.

While Swamishri was performing his morning puja, the vice-president of India, H.E. Bhaironsinh Shekhavat arrived for darshan. After puja the vice-president was given a tour of the under construction Swaminarayan Akshardham and then he returned to meet Swamishri.
